answer_1.quote: Text-to-text generation is an important research problem with a broad set of applications, such as dialog response generation, headline generation, and summarization.
answer_1.outputs: generated questions, dialog responses, headlines, and abstractive summaries

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU and ROUGE as automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: we further conduct human evaluation with the help of three external annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Closeness measures the similarity between the model output and target output. Relevancy considers the quality of model output directly with the source input. Fluency of the model output is on a scale of 1 (unreadable) to 4 (perfect).
